import sparknlp
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark: SparkSession = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .appName("Big Data")
    .master("local[*]")
    .config("spark.driver.memory", "8G")
    .config("spark.serializer", "org.apache.spark.serializer.KryoSerializer")
    .config("spark.driver.maxResultSize", "0")
    .config("spark.jars.packages", f"com.johnsnowlabs.nlp:spark-nlp_2.12:{sparknlp.__version__}")
    .getOrCreate()
)

```{python}
#| label: cache-files

import pathlib
cache_dir = pathlib.Path("cache")
cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

books_cache = cache_dir / "books.parquet"
library_cache = cache_dir / "library.parquet"
annotation_cache = cache_dir / "annotation.parquet"

do_annotation = not annotation_cache.exists()
dl_books = do_annotation and not (books_cache.exists() and library_cache.exists())
```

```{python}
#| label: download

from gutenbergpy.textget import get_text_by_id, strip_headers
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import ArrayType, StringType

@F.udf(ArrayType(StringType()))
def download_book(id):
    raw = get_text_by_id(id)
    text = strip_headers(raw).decode("utf-8").split("\n\n")
    clean = [p.strip().replace("\n", " ") for p in text]
    return [s for s in clean if s]

if dl_books:
    books = spark.read.csv("books.csv", header=True,
                           schema="author STRING, type STRING, title STRING, id INT")
    library = (
        books
        .select("id")
        .withColumn("text", download_book("id"))
        .select("id", F.posexplode("text").alias("p_id", "paragraph"))
    )
    books.write.parquet(str(books_cache))
    library.write.parquet(str(library_cache))
else:
    books = spark.read.parquet(str(books_cache))
    library = spark.read.parquet(str(library_cache))

books = books.persist()
```
